content:
“Introducing the Power Armor Carrying Kit.”

**Portable Power** is a Strength-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Reduces weight of all power armor parts and chassis.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★★ | 3 | +30% movement speed while wearing Power Armor. | 00310BFC | 
| ★★ | 2 | +20% movement speed while wearing Power Armor. | 00310BFB | 
| ★ | 1 | +10% movement speed while wearing Power Armor. | 00310BF9 | 

- Does not reduce the weight of power armor in stash.
- The perk has an effect only on power armor parts and chassis that are not worn by the player, since power armor worn does not count towards the total weight of the player.
- Before update 58, Portable Power was an Intelligence perk and had 3 ranks that reduced weight by 25%/50%/75%.

Sturdy Frame - perk that reduces weight of regular armor.
